tasks.title: Kit total
tasks.statement: Radio **${r}**, goggles **${g}**, BNF aircraft **${a}**, **{n}** batteries at **${p}** each, charger **${c}**, tools and consumables **$40**. How much does the kit cost ($)?
tasks.solution: The sum of the items: radio + goggles + aircraft + n·battery price + charger + 40. The simulator, shipping and taxes come on top.

tasks.title: How many batteries per session
tasks.statement: A **{c} mAh** battery, average current in flight **{i} A**, 80 % of the capacity is used. How many batteries are needed to fly at least **{t} min** per session? The answer is a whole number.
tasks.solution: Time per battery: t₁ = 0.8·Q/I (in hours) × 60. The number of batteries is t/t₁ rounded up: you cannot buy a fraction of a battery.

tasks.title: Parallel charging power
tasks.statement: **{n}** **{s}S {c} mAh** batteries are charged in parallel at 1C to 4.2 V per cell. What power must the charger deliver at the end of the charge (W)?
tasks.solution: In parallel the capacities add up: I = n·Q (1C), U = S·4.2 V, P = U·I. If the charger is weaker, it will reduce the current, and the charge will take more than an hour.
